findings: Insulation: miss=62.2ms vs hit=1.2ms under 60ms simulated latency; 23/60 independent cold requests failed under 50% loss (warm key needed 1 priming attempt(s) under the same loss). Correlation: with coalescing, 50/50 bursts of 10 were all-or-nothing (only 0 partial) at 30% loss, request failure rate 32.0%; without coalescing, 1/50 bursts were all-or-nothing (49 partial), request failure rate 29.2%. Both cells land near the target loss rate at the request-count level, but coalescing concentrates failure onto whole bursts instead of spreading it across individual requests within one.
